item.title: Pokoge ~Touhou Shisetsudan Ryoujokuki~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Poco Black
  • 発売日: 2006-12-29
  • スコア: なし (2 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ポコゲー ～東方使節団凌辱記～
  • 英語名: Pokoge Touhou Shisetsudan Ryoujokuki

あらすじ

There is a man who is no longer a human due to his tentacle body. He has a human heart, but hideous habits acquired during centuries. He acquires tremendous power and demands to be called “King of Tentacles”. Women become his play things. One day a ship arrives from the far east country. There is one thing that interests him in women missionaries in foreign clothes - how do they cry?

item.title: Pokoge ~Shokujara no Tou~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Poco Black
  • 発売日: 2006-09-26
  • スコア: なし (1 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ポコゲー ～触ジャラの塔～
  • 英語名: Pokoge Shokujara no Tou

あらすじ

Jet-black towers in the secluded mountains are rumored to bear countless treasures. Many adventurers ventured there, but none have returned. Today a new group of female adventurers come to the tower. They are captured and forced to play a game with the lord of the tower and his tentacle minions. If they win, they gain freedom. But if they lose, there is no limit to the humiliation to suffer.
